note: Per-case expectations for the requirement-resolution family. Written before any run and committed with the seal. Revision 2 of the deriver is frozen; running it here is the prospective test of whether its requirement model generalizes.

tasks.situation: op1 defines _bonus; op2 binds BONUS = _bonus() at import time
tasks.expect: the two are ordered; every removed boundary genuinely fails

tasks.situation: shout references _emph inside its body, resolved when shout RUNS
tasks.expect: no symbol ordering is derived; a textual mention is not a dependency

tasks.situation: def rule(n, ch=_dash()) - the default evaluates when the def executes
tasks.expect: ordered against _dash; this is the definition-time half of the phase distinction

tasks.situation: def star(n): return _mark() * n - the call happens when star RUNS
tasks.expect: NOT ordered; h03 and h04 differ only in where the helper call sits

tasks.situation: CONFIG.update(_extra()) and CONFIG.update(_more()) - the operation provides nothing
tasks.expect: ordered after BOTH helpers and after CONFIG; an operation can impose ordering through what it consumes

tasks.situation: SCALED = BASE * _factor() - BASE is a current program fact, _factor exists only because another planned operation creates it
tasks.expect: both requirements honoured, and the two sources are not collapsed - they carry different epistemic authority

tasks.situation: TAU = _round2(2 * math.pi) - math is bound by an import statement, which the provider search does not recognise
tasks.expect: the constraint is REAL and execution demands it, but the rule cannot find the provider. Deriving nothing is not the same answer as 'there is no dependency'. Must not invent ordering; the gap is expected to show as a MISS rather than an over-constraint.

tasks.situation: TAU = _round2(2 * PI) - identical to h07 except PI is a module constant
tasks.expect: fully ordered. h07 and h08 differ only in whether the provider arrives by import or by assignment, so a difference between them isolates the unresolved path.

matching: operation counts are {2,3,3,3} on the must-order half (h01,h03,h05,h06) and {2,3,3,3} on the must-not-order/unresolved half (h02,h04,h07,h08)
prior_standing: revision 2 scored 8/8 on the generalization family and 26/26 on the provenance family, both DEVELOPMENT evidence. It has no prospective standing before this run.
absence_rule: Absence of evidence is not evidence of absence. 'I found no provider' and 'there is no dependency' are different states, and h07 exists to make the difference measurable.
